# social-service-ea per-operation parity backlog

Baseline: `decentraland/social-service-ea@b6b2cefefdf727b2ed47ddb887e77d226a41eea6`. The machine source is [parity.json](parity.json).

The source inventory contains **123 operations**: 5 api_auxiliary, 72 api_http, 6 json_stream, 6 rpc_stream, 27 rpc_unary, 5 uws_http, 2 websocket.

reviewed means the stated source/behaviour scope was compared; it never means exhaustive equivalence. known_gap names a remaining observed difference. not_reviewed requires an explicit comparison, even if a matching route or local test exists.

Source hashes include the pinned service registrations, handlers, stream definitions, lockfile and the installed framework code that supplies health, CORS, metrics and fallback handling. `tooling/social-service-parity.py --upstream <checkout>` re-derives that inventory; the default check validates its complete backlog, local evidence references and the 33-method protocol set and complete source-pinned social-service/error/color schema hashes without an external checkout. The only other schema import is the standard `google/protobuf/empty.proto`.

Executed upstream handler cases live in [source-cases.json](source-cases.json); their Protobuf bytes are replayed by `rpc_wire_answers_match_executed_upstream_source_cases`. Those cases use injected dependencies and do not prove deployed HTTP, Redis, SNS, PostgreSQL or live-client equivalence.

## Shared gaps and replacement requirements

These requirements remain open even when an operation's focused review passes. A local implementation or a matching fixture does not establish a completed cutover.

| Requirement | Status | Evidence and remaining work |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `external-notification-consumers` | unverified | Configured friendship SNS producers now preserve source event fields, action key, retry timing and failure isolation through the existing official SDK publisher; local source/stub regressions pass. Existing external topic subscriptions, downstream consumers and deployed migration/cutover delivery remain unverified; community producer wiring is tracked separately. |
| `cross-replica-social-events` | unverified | Mutation fanout uses the existing core NATS link. Awaited publisher enqueue, synchronous targeted delivery and a 1,000-entry community work queue with at most min(4,pool size) SQL tasks deliver actual 1,000-update targeted/community bursts locally. Control traffic remains live; large public snapshots, process-local context restart and cache expiry are covered. Delivery remains transient and at most once. Deployed replica/consumer behavior, traffic beyond these measured bounds and outage/reconnect equivalence remain unverified. |
| `community-started-audience-lifetime` | unverified | Audience scope/generation/24-hour refreshed expiry now persist in shared SQL. Restart, expiry, generation-CAS and retained immutable event snapshots pass local tests. Existing room state, external media continuity and deployed cutover remain unverified. |
| `referral-lifecycle` | known_gap | Attribution/IP rejection, signup, UTC login days, guarded grants, artwork and email have source-paired/local regressions and optional official SQS/SNS transport. Referral/privacy PostgreSQL handler error envelopes are now source-replayed. Slack alert payloads/delivery and fractional numeric settings remain under correction; stateful cutover is unverified. |
| `community-ranking-and-configured-moderation` | known_gap | Dynamic moderators, ranking producers and configured AI compliance are implemented with focused source/local regressions. AI provider timeout/body bounds and missing-credential bootstrap behavior still differ. Existing lifetime counter baselines and watermarks are not imported, so historical ranking equality remains unverified. |
| `shared-fixed-window-friendship-limit` | unverified | The implemented SQL limiter now matches eight executed source/Redis scenarios plus concurrent replica, fixed-expiry and configuration regressions. Existing Redis counter state has not been imported or drained during a nonempty cutover; a fresh SQL counter resets the active window. |
| `cutover-with-existing-state` | unverified | No nonempty migration snapshot, deployed provider/edge configuration, active LiveKit call continuity, running-client comparison or rollback rehearsal has been supplied or executed. These are replacement acceptance requirements, separate from local contract tests. |
| `referral-external-cutover` | unverified | Configured official SQS/SNS transports preserve legacy raw events and attributes locally; deployed queue policies,topic subscriptions and real credential access have not been exercised. The additive upgrade preserves populated candidate IDs in synthetic tests; import of existing upstream progress/login-days/reward/email state and live cutover remain outstanding. Ranking event dispatch and friendship SNS producers now execute through the configured shared transport; community SNS producers and deployed cutover evidence remain outstanding. |
| `api-body-size-boundary` | known_gap | The pinned HTTP server applies HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES and rejects oversized declared bodies with413 before authentication; the current gateway still uses handler-level hardcoded limits. Declared/chunked body overflow, configured limits, response/CORS and connection-close behavior need a full boundary comparison and fix. |
| `shared-social-profile-cache` | known_gap | RPC and community adapters now share source 600-second SQL cache facts over the existing pool; independent-reader key/TTL/content-update/order/rawColor/error/upgrade/cleanup tests and 29 source steps pass. Strict single owner callsites are wired and 8 source handler cases pass. Exact mixed-case requested cache keys and case-sensitive source deduplication remain under correction. Existing Redis cache values and remaining TTL have not been imported or drained for cutover. |
| `community-dependency-error-boundaries` | known_gap | Core v1/v2 detail SQL failures now preserve source message-only 500 with executed-source/local regressions. Static comparison still confirms listing handlers catch unexpected dependency failures as 500 {message} while the candidate core listing SQL uses the generic envelope. Other community CRUD/list catches require individual failure injection; voice mutation error middleware remains separate. |
| `rpc-ordinary-transport-backpressure` | known_gap | The existing Social opt-in writer now bounds ordinary pending frames with the source adaptive count, retry/backoff/drain policy and accepted-once semantics. Fifteen supported-policy source traces replay; two additional cases document candidate startup rejection for maxBackpressure0 and computed nonfinite queue capacity where the source can admit unbounded buffering. WS_MAX_BACKPRESSURE still uses a strict unsigned parser rather than native numeric-prefix/fraction/wrap conversion. Application writer admission/flush is measured separately from native uWS kernel behavior; deployed performance equivalence is unverified. |
| `community-voice-status-failure-degradation` | known_gap | Pinned decentraland/comms-gatekeeper@be6a4b97a2189157884503485892ff46d0ac68da voice.ts catches single/bulk status database errors and returns idle status objects. Candidate community status currently participates in the main SQL statement, so a status-only SQL fault can abort that request instead of degrading. Normal liveness/count proofs and core community SQL error tests do not close this separate dependency-failure boundary. |
| `referral-numeric-configuration` | known_gap | Source configuration uses numeric-prefix/floating parsing for referral maximum-IP and minimum-day settings. Candidate strict integer settings reject fractional values at startup; source accepts them and may produce request-time PostgreSQL comparison errors or fractional day thresholds. Executed-source edge cases and matching conversion are in progress. |
| `rpc-text-frame-forwarding` | known_gap | Pinned authenticated RPC ws-handler forwards the received bytes for both text and binary WebSocket frames. The shared candidate reader currently discards text after authentication. A Social-only source-executed forwarding capture and actual text dRPC CreatePort regression/fix are in progress; other shared consumers retain their defaults. |
